about: The Pit's legends as Region 1 characters (Dom 2026-10-22: Dungeon 1 is the Gladiator Pit, its creatures are the Pit ladder's own legends). One rule row: how a legend becomes a character, a kill row and a creature-loot entry. origins/region1/legend-foes.ts derives one character per legend from the legend tables (src/fight/legend-rows.json + legend-families.json): its name, source and backstory from the legend row, its body from the family, its world level = its rank (1..10). Nothing about a single legend is written here.
